title: T1
characteristics: tissue: blood; diagnosis: ischemic stroke; age: 56
extract_protocol: HiSeq LncRNA-Seq; RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard illumina protocol
data_processing: seqenced reads were inmmed for adptor sequnce and masked for low-complexily sequence; mapped to human reference genome; Obtain mapped data(reads, etc., for subsequent transcription assembly and expression count; The distribution of reads compared to the genome in different regions of the reference genome was statistically analyzed, and the target regions were divided into CDS(coding region) Intron(Intron) Intergenic region and UTR(5' and 3 untranslated region).; The FPKM value of each gene/transcript in the sample was calculated, and the value was taken as the expression amount of gene/transcript in the sample; Genome_build: GRCh38.p13; Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Gene/transcript COUNT expression matrix
